note: migmag_process provides seven migrate process plugins (migmag_lookup, migmag_try, migmag_compare, migmag_target_bundle, migmag_get_entity_property, migmag_uuid_generate, migmag_logger_log) and the public service migmag_process.lookup.stub (MigMagMigrateStub). No config/UI/permissions/Drush. All plugins are discoverable via the core process plugin manager (plugin.manager.migrate.process), which works on this site even though the migration plugin manager is broken by pathauto - so evals are grounded in the process plugin manager, the container service, and module state, never a migration run. Baseline: migmag + migmag_process + migmag_rollbackable enabled; migmag_process_lookup_replace disabled. Introspection reads the live migmag_* process plugin list / stub service; execution enables the module (getting its plugins+service) and enables its child migmag_process_lookup_replace to swap migration_lookup to MigMagLookup.

evals.prompt: Which Migrate Magician process plugin is a smarter drop-in replacement for core's migration_lookup, and what is one problem it fixes compared to core?
evals.expected_output: migmag_lookup (class MigMagLookup). It only creates valid stubs, correctly identifies which migration contains a source row, can stub from partial source IDs, and supports stub_default_values - fixing core migration_lookup's invalid/wrong-migration stub problems.

evals.prompt: Which migmag_process process plugin wraps a process sub-pipeline in try/catch so you can return a fallback value when an exception is thrown, and what config key holds the fallback map?
evals.expected_output: migmag_try wraps the 'process' sub-pipeline in try/catch. Its 'catch' config maps exception FQCN => return value (default ['Exception' => NULL]); 'saveMessage' controls whether migrate messages are saved.

evals.prompt: What is the service id of the alternative migrate stub service that the migmag_process module registers, and what can it do that core's stub service cannot?
evals.expected_output: migmag_process.lookup.stub (class MigMagMigrateStub, extends core MigrateStub). It can create stubs for partial entity IDs (e.g. a reference to a translation/revision that resolves to a different base entity), which core's stub service cannot.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the migmag_process module is enabled. Inspect the running site's migrate process plugin manager and list the process plugin ids that Migrate Magician adds (they are prefixed migmag_).
evals.expected_output: The migmag_ prefixed process plugins are: migmag_lookup, migmag_try, migmag_compare, migmag_target_bundle, migmag_get_entity_property, migmag_uuid_generate, migmag_logger_log (from plugin.manager.migrate.process getDefinitions()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a Migrate Magician submodule has been enabled that forces core's migration_lookup process plugin to use Migrate Magician's implementation. Inspect the process plugin manager and report the class that migration_lookup now resolves to.
evals.expected_output: migmag_process_lookup_replace is enabled, so migration_lookup's class is now Drupal\migmag_process\Plugin\migrate\process\MigMagLookup (read via plugin.manager.migrate.process getDefinition('migration_lookup')['class']).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make Migrate Magician's extra migrate process plugins and its alternative migrate stub service available. Apply the change to the live site so that the migmag_lookup process plugin and the migmag_process.lookup.stub service both exist.
evals.expected_output: Enable the migmag_process module (drush en migmag_process -y). Afterwards plugin.manager.migrate.process exposes migmag_lookup (and the other migmag_ plugins) and the container has the migmag_process.lookup.stub service.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, using Migrate Magician, force core's migration_lookup process plugin to use migmag_process's MigMagLookup implementation for all migrations, without editing migration YAML. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the migmag_process_lookup_replace submodule (drush en migmag_process_lookup_replace -y); its hook_migrate_process_info_alter sets migration_lookup's class to MigMagLookup.
